gap: No result ChatGPT got states which Sonos speakers can actually take a Bluetooth turntable's signal: Sonos's own list is Arc Ultra, Beam Ultra, Era 100, Era 100 SL, Era 300, Move 2, Roam, Roam 2, Roam SL and Sonos Play. Sonos also says Roam cannot pass Bluetooth audio on to other Sonos speakers, and Bluetooth is turned off on portable speakers set up as surrounds.
standout_why: I compared against turntableverse.com/best-bluetooth-turntables (rank 1–2 in both chats). It already says every pick only sends Bluetooth and does not receive it, that the speaker or headphones must support aptX or aptX Adaptive for those codecs to work, that Bluetooth adds a small delay, and in general terms that Sonos's 'Bluetooth-capable speakers can pair with a Bluetooth turntable'. It does not name which Sonos models those are, does not say Roam can't pass the audio to other rooms, and does not say whether a deck plays to more than one speaker at once. It only notes that the PS-LX310BT 'can pair with up to eight devices'. ChatGPT's second chat also states the send-only rule. The What Hi-Fi page (the cited rival) came back empty to my fetch, so I could not check it. vinylpickup.com failed on a TLS certificate error.
decides: This doesn't change the turntable pick, because all the candidates send standard Bluetooth audio. It settles whether the plan works for a shopper who picks ChatGPT's 'Sonos or other wireless home audio system' option. If their Sonos speaker is on the list, Bluetooth from any of these decks works, and the speaker can share the music to the rest of the Sonos system (except Roam). If their Sonos speaker is not on the list, the Bluetooth feature is useless to them. They need a wired connection to a Sonos product with a line-in, so the deck's switchable RCA preamp output matters more than its codec.

findings.label: Sonos products that can share Bluetooth audio (maker's list)
findings.value: Arc Ultra, Beam Ultra, Era 100, Era 100 SL, Era 300, Move 2, Roam, Roam 2, Roam SL, Sonos Play
findings.source_title: Share Bluetooth audio with your Sonos system
findings.note: Sonos introduces the list with 'The following Sonos products can share Bluetooth audio:'. The article has no separate list of products that only receive Bluetooth. It does not mention models outside this list (for example One, Five, original Arc or Beam), and it says nothing about delay.

findings.label: Sonos models that cannot pass Bluetooth audio to other Sonos speakers
findings.value: Roam, Sonos Ace, Sonos Ace Ultra
findings.source_title: Share Bluetooth audio with your Sonos system
findings.note: Sonos says these 'cannot' swap Bluetooth audio to and from other Sonos products. So a turntable paired to a Roam plays on that Roam only.
